definitions.explanation: An electrical appliance used for washing clothes automatically.

examples.japanese: {洗濯機|せんたくき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{回|まわ}す→回す：01158_mawasu⟧。
{洗濯機|せんたくき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{壊|こわ}れた→壊れる：00791_kowareru⟧⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: I bought a new one because the washing machine broke.

examples.japanese: ⟦ドラム→ドラム：04463_doramu⟧⟦{式|しき}→〜式：02000_shiki⟧{洗濯機|せんたくき}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{節水|せっすい}→節水：07964_sessui⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: Drum-type washing machines can save water.

notes:
TYPES:
- ⟦{縦型|たてがた}→縦型：30883_tategata⟧{洗濯機|せんたくき}: top-loader, the traditional type in Japan
- ⟦ドラム→ドラム：04463_doramu⟧{式|しき}{洗濯機|せんたくき}: front-loading drum type
- {二槽式|にそうしき}{洗濯機|せんたくき}: twin-tub, an older style with separate wash and spin tubs
- {洗濯乾燥機|せんたくかんそうき}: washer-dryer

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {洗濯機|せんたくき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{回|まわ}す→回す：01158_mawasu⟧: to run the washing machine
- {洗濯機|せんたくき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧: to put in the washing machine
- {洗濯機|せんたくき}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{洗|あら}う→洗う：00827_arau⟧: to machine-wash

USAGE:
The cycle names on the controls are {洗|あら}い (wash), すすぎ (rinse), ⟦{脱水|だっすい}→脱水：10926_dassui⟧ (spin), and ⟦{乾燥|かんそう}→乾燥：00184_kansou⟧ (dry).
